svg.aria-label: Career timeline, 2018 to 2026. A B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University with a CGPA of 3.83, including an Erasmus+ exchange semester at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznan. Applied machine learning research runs from 2020 to now — ten papers, 185 citations, h-index 4 — alongside peer review for four journals and three conferences. Industry work moves from GraphQL backend-for-frontend services in Java at BJIT Group, to the National Board of Revenue customs bond system in Spring Boot and Oracle at REVE Systems, to .NET 9 platform architecture at Akij iBOS leading a team of ten, with open-source and personal builds alongside.
svg.title: Two threads, one instinct — eight years of engineering and research

svg.text: Production engineering and applied research in parallel since 2018 — Java, .NET and Python, three companies, ten papers.
